claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Marbofloxacin is a veterinary fluoroquinolone antibacterial with no meaningful activity against human cancer cells at 2.5 uM; its annotated target (bacterial DNA gyrase) is absent in human cells, and no cytotoxic off-target effect is expected at this concentration.
